_meta.title: HyperEdit Color Correction
_meta.description: Load image frames → EasyColorCorrection (auto mode) → SaveImage. Used by the COLOR agent for per-frame correction and creative grading.

template_vars.INPUT_IMAGE_PATH: Absolute path to input image or frame (e.g. /tmp/frames/frame_0001.png)
template_vars.OUTPUT_PREFIX: Filename prefix for saved output (e.g. corrected_frame_0001)
template_vars.PRESET_NAME: Used when mode=Preset. One of the 30 built-in looks (e.g. Cinematic, Warm, Cold)
template_vars.REFERENCE_IMAGE_PATH: Optional: path to reference image for color matching (leave null to skip)
